verdict.rationale: The evidence shows GitLab has native issues: community users praise its issue tracking, the GitHub importer brings issues and labels into GitLab, and the docs reference triggering agents from an issue. It does not document labels or assignees on issues, or tracking requirements specifically. missing for 10: first-party documentation of issue labels and assignees, evidence of assignee support, requirements or issue-type tracking for bugs, features and requirements.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track bugs, features, and requirements as issues with labels and assignees
